# eLife

> > eLife is an open-access journal publishing peer-reviewed research across the life and biomedical sciences, from neuroscience and genetics to cell biology and disease mechanisms.

eLife features cutting-edge research articles on topics including neuropsychiatric disorders, RNA biology, synaptic plasticity, and neurodegenerative diseases. The journal showcases work from leading institutions like the Rockefeller University and University of California, Los Angeles, advancing our understanding of complex biological systems and disease pathways.

## Key Topics

- Neuropsychiatric disorders
- Wolfram syndrome (WFS1 gene)
- Huntington's disease
- Alzheimer's disease
- RNA binding proteins (nELAVL, ELAV-like proteins)
- Synaptic plasticity
- Neural circuits and stress pathways
- Depression mechanisms
- Brain transcriptomics
- RNA splicing and Y RNA regulation
- CLIP-seq methodology
- Neurogenetic modeling
- Nanoconnectomics
- Neurodegenerative disease mechanisms

## Neuropsychiatric and Neurodegenerative Disease Research

- [Neuropsychiatric Disorders: Probing the stress and depression circuits with a disease gene](https://elifesciences.org/articles/10829): Research on WFS1 gene's role in stress and depression neural circuits
- [Regulatory consequences of neuronal ELAV-like protein binding to coding and non-coding RNAs in human brain](https://elifesciences.org/articles/10421): nELAVL protein binding to Y RNAs in Alzheimer's disease brains

## Synaptic and Cellular Neuroscience

- [Nanoconnectomic upper bound on the variability of synaptic plasticity](https://elifesciences.org/articles/10778): Electron microscopy study of synaptic plasticity in hippocampal dendrites
